tools.name: get_big_mac_index
tools.description: The Fast Food Index Big Mac index: the national median Big Mac price across priced US McDonald's restaurants, its range and extremes, and the median by state with each state vs the national figure. Data collected weekly from McDonald's own ordering system.

tools.name: get_chain_overview
tools.description: Every chain Fast Food Index prices (10 US chains): flagship item, its national median price and range, and restaurants priced. Data collected weekly from the chains' own ordering systems.

tools.name: get_item_price
tools.description: The price of one menu item at one chain: national median, typical range, restaurants priced, and the cheapest / priciest states (for flagship items) or stores. Chain accepts names like "McDonald's", "taco bell", "bk".

tools.name: get_state_prices
tools.description: One US state: its fast-food price index position (percent vs the national basket) and the flagship item medians in that state (Big Mac, Whopper, Chick-fil-A Chicken Sandwich, Crunchwrap Supreme where priced). Accepts a state name or abbreviation.

tools.name: get_price_changes
tools.description: The latest verified fast-food price changes: gated repricing events (same item, same old and new price, at 40+ restaurants) from the most recent weekly collection round.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search priced menu items by name across all 10 chains (e.g. "nuggets", "frosty", "burrito"). Returns matching items with national medians and restaurant counts.
